title: Distributed Cross-Channel Hierarchical Aggregation for Foundation Models
problem: Tokenizing and aggregating multi-channel images for foundation models is compute-intensive
motivation: Vision-based scientific foundation models need efficient processing of high-channel-count imagery (hyperspectral, weather)
method: D-CHAG (Distributed Cross-Channel Hierarchical Aggregation): hierarchical channel aggregation compatible with tensor parallelism/model sharding
key_novelty: Distributed hierarchical aggregation for multi-channel vision transformers with 75% memory reduction and 2x throughput improvement
